title: Adding Two Negabinary Numbers
summary: Given two negabinary numbers represented as arrays of 0s and 1s, add them and return the result as an array of 0s and 1s, ensuring no leading zeros.
statement: Given two negabinary numbers represented as arrays of 0s and 1s, add them and return the result as an array of 0s and 1s, ensuring no leading zeros. Each number is an array starting with 1, representing a negabinary value from the most significant bit to the least significant bit.
constraints: Inputs are canonical base -2 digit arrays.
Return their sum without leading zeros except [0].
hints: At each position choose a binary output digit with the same parity as the total.
The remaining value divided by -2 becomes carry=-(total>>1).
Process both arrays from right to left, trim high zeros, and reverse.
The invariant exactly preserves the unprocessed base -2 value plus carry.
editorial: The invariant exactly preserves the unprocessed base -2 value plus carry.

tests.explanation: The values eleven and five sum to sixteen, represented as 10000.
Zero plus zero remains canonical zero.
